criteria.title: measured content margins are multiples of 4 epx
criteria.requirement: every margin and padding is a multiple of 4 epx (visual spec sections 1.3 and 2.1)

evidence.method: frame-excluded edge detection on the PNG

criteria.reason: edge detection alone cannot decide the 4 epx grid: the first painted pixel is an anti-aliased glyph or a full-bleed background, not the layout box. Needs XAML static analysis or an instrumented layout dump.

criteria.title: font sizes come from the built-in type ramp
criteria.requirement: no hand-picked font size; sizes come from the 12/14/18/20/28/40 scale (visual spec sections 4.2 and 12)
criteria.reason: the managed UI Automation API in-package exposes no reliable font-size attribute, and a screenshot cannot be reduced to numeric font sizes without an OCR step. Needs XAML static analysis or an explicitly instrumented automation property.

criteria.title: status is not conveyed by colour alone
criteria.requirement: state must be readable without colour (visual spec section 8.2)

evidence.note: the UIA tree does carry names for status elements, but textual/iconic redundancy per state is a design judgement

criteria.reason: deciding this from pixels plus UIA names would require a per-state mapping that the tool does not have; a human must compare the state samples

criteria.title: body text contrast is at least 4.5:1
criteria.requirement: visible text has a luminance contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background (visual spec section 8.2)

evidence.note: the PNG contains the text, but pairing pixels to text spans needs OCR or a layout dump

criteria.reason: no text-to-pixel binding is available, so per-span contrast cannot be computed; a text-cluster contrast approximation is deliberately NOT used because it would produce a false pass

criteria.title: the four built-in contrast themes were exercised
criteria.requirement: the app is walked through the four built-in contrast themes (visual spec sections 8.4 and 12)
criteria.reason: this tool does not switch contrast themes (that is a system accessibility setting) and no per-theme comparison is implemented, so the claim cannot be evidenced here

criteria.title: hover / open-overlay states were captured
criteria.requirement: disabled, hover and open-overlay states each have at least one screenshot (visual spec section 7.4 and section 9)

evidence.note: capture-window.ps1 implements move/click/wheel steps, but no page in this run declared them

criteria.reason: the configured page list declares no hover/click step, so no hover or overlay evidence exists. Concluding anything about those states would be fabrication.

criteria.title: the audit is tied to the exact spec revision
criteria.requirement: the report records the SHA256 of the spec it was measured against

criteria.title: every PNG matches its window dimensions
criteria.requirement: the capture is 1:1 with the window, so measured pixels are usable as layout evidence

criteria.title: each captured state is a distinct frame
criteria.requirement: the tool did not emit several shots of the same moment

criteria.title: no orphaned application process is left behind
criteria.requirement: the audit cleans up after itself (idempotent reruns)

criteria.title: the report is traceable to the exact artefact
criteria.requirement: timestamp plus executable SHA256 plus spec SHA256 plus git revision

criteria.title: the report itself is complete
criteria.requirement: a report with at least one real screenshot, at least 10 criteria and non-empty PNG files

criteria.title: every non-pass criterion states a reason
criteria.requirement: an unverifiable or failing criterion must say what was missing, so it cannot be silently ignored
